name: Alaweo
desc: Alaweo (Chenopodium oahuense): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Chenopodium oahuense is a species of flowering plant in the amaranth family known by the common names aweoweo, alaweo, alaweo huna, aheahea, ahea, ahewahewa, and kahaihai.
